summary: A great surprise list: everyone guesses island nations, but Sweden, Norway and Finland take the top three. Players find most of it and argue about the rest.
reasons: Every answer is a country everyone knows, and the twist (Scandinavia, Canada, Chile ahead of Indonesia) makes a strong reveal.

The prompt pulls players toward small island nations (Maldives #29, Fiji #47, New Zealand #39), which cost lives; Greece #13 and UK #12 are fair near misses. The casual player ran out of lives at 7/10.
Excellent Blitz: almost any country scores.
fixes: Drop junk aliases copied from table notes: 'See United Kingdom.' (Scotland) and 'See China.' (Hong Kong); also 'Swedish sin' (Sweden).
Scotland (#34) and Hong Kong (#48) are not countries and double count the UK and China; consider dropping them from the answers.
